title: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: Suppose your school is organizing an orientation program to help the freshmen adapt to the new environment and academic studies. You are now to write a proposal, which may include its aim, duration, participants and activities. You will have 30 minutes to write the proposal. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: A Proposal for the Freshmen Orientation Program Our school is planning an orientation program for this year's freshmen, and its main arrangements are proposed below. The program aims to help new students adapt to the new environment and academic studies as smoothly and quickly as possible. In terms of duration, the program will last for one week, starting from the day of registration. As for the participants, it is open to all incoming freshmen, and it will be organized by the Student Union together with volunteer seniors and several advisers from each department. A variety of activities will be arranged during the week. First, campus tours and library workshops will help newcomers find their way around. Second, group meetings with academic advisers will introduce course selection and effective study methods. Finally, evening social parties will give students a chance to make new friends and relax. We are confident that this program will give every freshman a warm and confident start. Your approval and support would be highly appreciated. The Student Union
keyPoints: 标题＋主旨句落地。本段用标题 A Proposal for the Freshmen Orientation Program 点 题，开头句 our school is planning ... arrangements are proposed below 总起，再用 The program aims to help new students adapt ... 把 aim 前置，正是『开头一句亮方案主旨』方法的落地。

两标签领出两要点。In terms of duration 领出『one week, starting from the day of registration』写死时长，As for the participants 领出『all incoming freshmen』『organized by the Student Union ...』写清人员，一句一要点，覆盖 duration 与 participants。

First/Second/Finally 写实活动。先用 A variety of activities will be arranged 总起，再以 First / Second / Finally 分列三类活动，且每条都补了作用（help newcomers find their way around、introduce course selection、make new friends），实现『分点罗列活动』且不空泛。
信心＋请求＋组织落款。We are confident that ... a warm and confident start 表信心并回 扣目的，Your approval and support would be highly appreciated 客气请求批准，末行以 The Student Union 落款，避免出现真名。
